title: March 19, 2026 CMS approval of Minnesota Medicaid Corrective Action Plan
locator: Attachment A, PDF pp.10-11 / document pages headed March 19, 2026
supports: CMS states that Minnesota's 2025-12-31 CAP had deficiencies and that CMS identified required revisions in a 2026-01-12 communication.
CMS states Minnesota's revised CAP submitted 2026-01-30 addressed those deficiencies and explicitly concludes: 'Therefore, the CAP is approved.'
CMS states Minnesota had met the February 1 and March 1 milestones and expected continued implementation, weekly reporting, and milestone-based meetings until completion.
CMS identified off-cycle revalidation of high-risk provider types as a critical initiative and requested continued outcome/status reporting.
CMS requested that Minnesota's appeal of the January 6 potential withholding action be stayed pending complete implementation of the approved CAP because successful completion would moot the appeal.
important_qualifications: CAP approval does not mean CMS found all underlying program-integrity problems cured; the letter expressly requires continued implementation and monitoring.
Approval of the CAP is separate from the February 2026 federal-funds deferral and does not convert deferred amounts into fraud findings.

The standalone March 19 PDF has not been separately indexed on cms.gov in this research pass, but the complete signed letter is embedded as Attachment A in an official Medicaid.gov/CMS PDF, providing a primary federal source.
